paragraphs: [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5) says that they are Rabbah and Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara identifies the amoraim of Pumbedita as Rabbah and Rav Yosef, as does [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=565&lang=en). It lists the court judges, elders and sharp scholars of Pumbedita separately.
